notes: Each scenario fixes the expected artifacts, invalidations, parse/render/bundle targets, diagnostics and previous-output retention before any optimization.
coverage=existing means an existing test already asserts the expectation; partial means part of the expectation is unasserted; gap means no assertion exists yet.
A gap names the task that must add the assertion. Scenarios are not deleted or renamed without recording the old and new id.
Numerical targets stay in the plan (§5); this file only fixes the semantics that a measurement or counter must preserve.

expected.artifacts: Every published artifact keeps its byte hash; no new or removed files.
expected.parseRenderBundleTargets: 0 documents parsed, 0 pages rendered, 0 entries bundled

expected.artifacts: Changed page HTML plus dependent surfaces (search index, feed, sitemap when the body contributes) change; unrelated pages keep their hashes.
TOC/navigation for the page and dependent documents change; body-only pages stay.
Title surfaces change (page title, feed title, navigation label) while the body parse stays reusable.
Old artifact is removed and the new route artifact is written; inbound links and navigation entries update.
expected.parseRenderBundleTargets: 1 page rendered under a new route
expected.previousOutputRetention: the old artifact must not survive as an unowned file

scenarios.gapDetail: No test edits only the slug front matter key and asserts the invalidation set.

expected.artifacts: Added page appears; deleted page artifact and ownership entry disappear; renamed page keeps neither the old artifact nor a stale cache entry.
expected.parseRenderBundleTargets: only the added/renamed documents are parsed and rendered

expected.artifacts: Asset references keep pointing at the same paths; page HTML changes only where the asset fingerprint is embedded.
expected.previousOutputRetention: removed assets leave no orphan artifact

expected.artifacts: Including page changes; other pages that include a different region stay.
expected.diagnostics: missing or unterminated regions keep their explicit diagnostic and location

expected.artifacts: All pages using the layout change; unrelated layouts stay.
Route table, navigation, public URLs and sitemap update consistently; collisions fail before output mutation.
invalidations: social image paths when they embed the route
expected.parseRenderBundleTargets: only documents whose public route changed
expected.diagnostics: collision and invalid route diagnostics keep their ids and refuse to publish
expected.previousOutputRetention: the previous output tree stays intact when preflight fails

scenarios.gapDetail: The invalidation set for a route-only change is not asserted with counters.

expected.artifacts: Version switcher and variant navigation update; other versions keep their content.
expected.diagnostics: missing variants stay explicit rather than silently reused

expected.artifacts: Only artifacts whose inputs changed are regenerated; a settings change invalidates the affected plan or renderer fingerprint.
expected.parseRenderBundleTargets: depends on the setting; must be explained by the fingerprint, not by mtime

expected.artifacts: Damaged or deleted output is detected and rewritten; unrelated output keeps its bytes.
expected.parseRenderBundleTargets: recovery must not require a full reparse when the cache is intact

expected.artifacts: Output is regenerated to the same bytes as a clean build; unknown or corrupt cache versions are discarded safely.
expected.parseRenderBundleTargets: full reparse allowed only for the discarded entries
expected.diagnostics: tampered ownership or cache state fails closed without changing the published tree
expected.previousOutputRetention: published tree hash is unchanged on failure

expected.artifacts: The last successful published tree is preserved; a later successful run converges to the newest inputs.
expected.diagnostics: failure diagnostics are returned separately from the retained output
expected.previousOutputRetention: required; byte hash of the published tree before and after the failure must match

expected.artifacts: Static HTML changes for the edited page; interactive entries that the page does not use are neither rebundled nor rehashed.
expected.parseRenderBundleTargets: 0 rebundled interactive entries for static-only content

scenarios.gapDetail: The 1.1.0 counter gate (no unrelated interactive entry rebundle) has no asserting test or counter yet.

expected.artifacts: Only entries that import the changed component are rebundled; unrelated entries keep their bytes.
invalidations: dependency closure of the changed component

expected.artifacts: Every entry that depends on the runtime (or on a shared CSS asset) is updated; missing one is a failure, not an optimization.
expected.parseRenderBundleTargets: all dependent entries, verified by counter and artifact list
